title: Build output size history
responsibility: Shows recorded emitted sizes and limits separately for each build target.

inputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth.unit
inputs.description: Required unit identifier used to label this history.

inputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth.growth
inputs.description: Required target definitions and revision rows, including sizes, changes, limits and review notes. Targets remain separate rather than being added together.

inputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth.reasons
inputs.description: Required lookup for recorded explanations at a commit. A changed row without explanations says none were recorded.

inputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth.oncompare
inputs.description: Required callback invoked with the commit when the user chooses before-and-after evidence.

outputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth
outputs.description: Per-target size history with signed changes and review notes. Missing sizes remain unavailable; missing limits distinguish reviewed nonbuildable targets from targets with no limit yet.
